title: Casper and the Static
author: Lena Brightwater
blurb: Oscar Marchetti, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
